sources.title: Transformer Feed-Forward Layers Build Predictions by Promoting Concepts in the Vocabulary Space
sources.read_scope: Official abstract and bibliography rechecked now. The older N30 record separately documents selected paper sections.
sources.consequence: FFN vocabulary contributions and prediction control are prior work. A comparator-score effect is not a new method or a semantic algorithm.

sources.title: Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability
sources.read_scope: Official abstract and bibliography rechecked now; earlier scoped definitions are in the N16 literature record.
sources.consequence: Donor interventions need a specified high-level variable and counterfactual controls. This small native-group assay is not a proof of formal causal abstraction.

sources.title: Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for? An Interpretability Illusion for Subspace Activation Patching
sources.read_scope: Official abstract and version metadata only.
sources.consequence: Behavioral control need not identify the natively used feature. Even a passing transfer screen would not establish native semantic necessity.
